findings.title: Missing validation for coordinate ranges in getMeterLocation
findings.description: The getMeterLocation function parses lat/lon coordinates but does not validate they are within valid geographic ranges (lat: -90 to 90, lon: -180 to 180).
findings.fix: Add range validation: parsed.lat >= -90 && parsed.lat <= 90 && parsed.lon >= -180 && parsed.lon <= 180 for both JSON and CSV parsing paths.

findings.title: Redis retry strategy could use more conservative backoff
findings.description: The retry strategy Math.min(times * 50, 2000) retries too aggressively. For a cache layer with graceful degradation, exponential backoff is more appropriate.
findings.fix: Use exponential backoff: Math.min(Math.pow(2, times) * 100, 5000) for retry intervals (100ms, 200ms, 400ms, 800ms... up to 5s).

findings.title: Incomplete error boundary specification for frontend components
findings.description: Design specifies loading and error states but does not mention error boundaries or how to recover from failed API calls in the UI.
findings.fix: Add retryCount to dashboard state and implement handleRetry function with retry button in error banner UI.

summary.recommendation: APPROVED - Proceed to implementation. All HIGH and MEDIUM findings from previous review have been resolved. The three NIT findings are minor improvements that do not block implementation.
